spec_text_or_path: Summon Reaper's signature sustain: the Reaper passively weakens and CONSUMES the player's OTHER minions to heal and temporarily empower itself ('will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself'; +30% increased AoE when consuming other minions). Family siblings already docketed: animate-weapon b01 (ground-items-as-summon-fuel), bladefall-bladeblast b02 (placed-field-as-detonation-queue), dark-pact b02 (proxy-max-life-as-per-cast-ammo). Reaper is the FOURTH accrual and a new direction within the family: the CONSUMER is itself a proxy (proxy eats sibling proxies for sustain/empowerment), not the caster spending proxies as ammo. No engine lane: proxy sustain draws from resummon/upkeep economy, never from consuming sibling entities. Mapped as a single-sovereign melee proxy (APPROX/MAPPED, dark-pact R-M7 precedent — visible loop intact). The b02 steward note already suggested consolidating this family into ONE entity-as-consumable-resource-pool docket — this row is further evidence for that consolidation. NOTE: kit is negative=1 (trap-canon: 'the anti-synergy killed it; clunky, starving') — the gap record doubles as failure-taxonomy evidence: the missing lane is precisely the mechanism that killed the source build, so a ruling of 'flavor-only, approximation canonical' would also be a ruling that the engine version sheds the source's fatal anti-synergy.

Iron Commander Siege Ballista's identity: '+1 to maximum number of Summoned Totems per 200 Dexterity' — gear/attribute stacking literally COUNTS the turret army (econ_raw=stat-counts-army); every itemization decision is visible as army growth. Engine: totem proxies are native (geometry totem), attribute-stacking gear affixes are native (trait lane), but proxy COUNT is generation-fixed — no lane binds a stat VALUE to entity count. Ladder audit: map (totem battery OK) -> approximate+note (fixed count; DEX regresses to ordinary stat scaling; grade APPROX, deviation mandatory) -> quantitative mint? NO — not a widen of an existing param (no stat->count parameter exists to extend, and merely raising max totem count would NOT land the identity) -> qualitative mint-candidate (a NEW coupling mechanism: attribute-value drives proxy-count), evidence-gated, filed as docket for steward ruling: (a) mint an attribute->proxy-count coupling primitive, or (b) rule stat-counting flavor-only with fixed-count-battery + attribute-traits as the canonical approximation. Single-kit evidence so far; other stat-counts-a-thing kits (D2 '+skill per charge' lineages, PoE stacked-attribute uniques) may accrue — steward should sweep before minting.

spec_text_or_path: Dead Reckoning skeleton mages 'cast ranged fire, cold, or lightning spell projectiles' — each mage/cast rolls from the tri-element pool, and the meta forces mono-cold via conversion gearing (Triad-Grip register): exactly the b0x elemental-hit pattern (random-roll-then-curate-the-pool; Combat Focus jewels there, conversion gloves here). The elemental-hit docket explicitly asked the steward to check accrual across the corpus before minting an RNG-element-pool + pruning primitive — this row is that accrual: 2 kits now attest the substrate. Distinction from elemental-hit: there the pool-sculpting IS the gameplay (APPROX); here the delivery-mode flip (melee skeletons -> ranged caster squad) is the identity and the element roulette is meta-deleted flavor, so skeleton-mages is graded CLOSE and mapped to the mono-cold endpoint. Filed purely as accrual evidence, not a new candidate class.
